Title: Integration tests fail to compile
Description: Test files have import errors referencing removed modules (web, TUI, old database APIs). Files affected: edge_case_testing.rs, monitoring_reporting.rs, database_crud.rs
Reproduction Steps:
1. Run 'cargo test --features cli-standard --tests'
2. Observe compilation errors
3. Check import statements in test files
Mitigation: Skip integration tests for v0.0.2 release. Rely on unit tests and manual testing. Document in release notes.

Title: Security detector regex patterns use unsupported features
Description: Security detectors use lookahead/lookbehind regex assertions (?!) which are not supported by Rust regex crate. Affects 12+ security detector tests and production functionality.
Reproduction Steps:
1. Run unit tests
2. Check failures in security detector tests
3. Review regex patterns in src/analysis/detectors/security/
Mitigation: Rewrite regex patterns without lookahead/lookbehind. Use alternative matching strategies (character classes, word boundaries).

Title: Database tests fail due to state pollution
Description: Tests create tables that persist between runs, causing 'table already exists' errors. Affects test_concurrent_connections and test_connection_execution.
Reproduction Steps:
1. Run 'cargo test --lib' twice
2. Second run will fail with table exists errors
3. Delete test database files to reset
Mitigation: Implement proper test isolation with unique table names or cleanup hooks. Use tempfile for test databases.
